test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underline word.

They denied having any __associasion__ with the terrorists.
solution:
The correct answer is "**association.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is "association."
 
• **The word is a noun that refers to a group of people or an organization that has a common purpose or interest**.
 
 
• ​Example: He ceased to be a member of the association.
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the words mentioned in options 1, 2 and 3 are incorrect.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
